connector.name: Unifi
connector.registryDescription: UniFi semantic-analysis MCP - fleet health, anomaly detection, cross-site analytics
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package unifi-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the us-all account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UNIFI_API_URL
env.description: UniFi Site Manager API base URL (default: https://api.ui.com).

env.name: UNIFI_API_KEY_OWNER
env.description: Owner-role API key — enables 33 Cloud Connector tools for per-device/per-client deep data.

env.name: UNIFI_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated category allowlist. Default: all categories enabled.

env.name: UNIFI_LOCAL_URL
env.description: Local controller URL (e.g. https://10.10.1.1). Enables 2 local-only tools (get-port-errors, list-port-flap-summary) that surface per-port errors + SFP DDM the Cloud API does not expose. Requires LAN reachability.

env.name: UNIFI_LOCAL_USER
env.description: Controller local account username (required when UNIFI_LOCAL_URL set). Viewer/Limited-Admin role is sufficient.

env.name: UNIFI_LOCAL_PASS
env.description: Controller local account password (required when UNIFI_LOCAL_URL set).

env.name: UNIFI_LOCAL_INSECURE
env.description: Set to 'true' to accept self-signed cert from the local controller (typical for UDM Pro).
